title: Newport, Monday
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Five a week now. The first one is about the drive.

panels.composition: Highway 101 north, morning, fog. An old Datsun, WOOD driving, the pad on the passenger seat.

image.prompt: an old Datsun driving north on a foggy two-lane coastal highway between walls of spruce, a young man at the wheel, a drawing pad on the passenger seat, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: The community college sign: OREGON COAST COMMUNITY COLLEGE — NEWPORT. Wood turning in.

image.prompt: a small community college entrance sign in fog with an old Datsun turning in

panels.composition: Wood, parked, engine off, to the pad.

characters.pose: in the car, pad on the wheel

balloons.text: Twenty minutes each way. Five days. That's two hundred minutes a week of thinking. I could write a novel in the car.

image.prompt: close-up of a young man in a parked car resting a drawing pad on the steering wheel and talking to it

panels.composition: The pad: a drawing of the drive. Just the drive. The novel is not on it.
props: a drawing of a foggy highway

image.prompt: close-up of a drawing pad on a steering wheel showing a quick brush-pen sketch of a foggy coastal highway, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen now — the weekday deadline teaches the hand to commit; still xeroxed, still black and white
art.paper: the college paper's newsprint; the digest's quarter-letter xerox

notes: The first weekday daily. The line loosens on day one.
